{{Quote|Using a lightsaber is just as much science as art.|Master Ruus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Ruus''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Fair-skinned with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] as well as a beard and mustache, Ruus carried a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and wore shoulder [[Armor/Legends|armor]] over their tan and yellow [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]]. Ruus was stationed on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where theyand the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tephan (Jedi)|Tephan]] maintained a base in the [[Senate Commercial District]]'s eastern wing.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ruus first appeared as a Jedi Knight trainer in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
